plan.title: Scholarship Application Summary
plan.subtitle: Overview of scholarship applications by category and status

panels.title: Total Applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Applications by Category
panels.sql: SELECT "Category", COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Applications by Status
panels.sql: SELECT "Status", COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 10 Applicants by Marks
panels.sql: SELECT "Naam", "Marks %" FROM scholarship_applicants ORDER BY "Marks %" DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The total number of scholarship applications received is {{p1}}. The distribution of applications across different categories is shown in the bar chart, with the most applications coming from the '{{p2.x[0]}}' category. The status of these applications varies, with the most common status being '{{p3.x[0]}}'. The table highlights the top 10 applicants based on their marks percentage.
